name: SpotifyBU
description: SpotifyBU uses Spotify metadata to build and maintain a Navidrome-ready local music backup, with optional Navidrome or Plex playlist sync. Set PUID/PGID to match NaviClean/Navidrome when sharing the same music library.

paths.name: Config Folder
paths.description: Stores SpotifyBU settings and changed app login credentials

paths.name: Navidrome Music Library
paths.description: Host music folder that Navidrome scans. This must be the real music folder, not Navidrome appdata/config. SpotifyBU needs read/write access and stores its index under /music/.spotifybu.

ports.name: Web Port
ports.description: Container 3000 - Host port for the SpotifyBU web UI

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Unraid user ID used by SpotifyBU for /config and /music access. Match NaviClean/Navidrome on shared libraries; 99 is Unraid's default nobody user.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Unraid group ID used by SpotifyBU for /config and /music access. Match NaviClean/Navidrome on shared libraries; 100 is Unraid's default users group.

variables.name: Spotify Client ID
variables.description: Spotify Developer Dashboard app Client ID. SpotifyBU uses PKCE and does not need or ask for the Spotify Client Secret.

variables.name: SpotifyBU App Secret
variables.description: Long random value used to sign SpotifyBU's own login sessions. This is not your Spotify app Client Secret.

variables.name: Navidrome URL
variables.description: Navidrome URL as seen by the SpotifyBU container. Used with optional Navidrome credentials to ping Navidrome and request server-side scans.

variables.name: Navidrome Username
variables.description: Optional Navidrome username. Required only if SpotifyBU should ping Navidrome and request a Navidrome-side library scan after indexing or staging files.

variables.name: Navidrome Password
variables.description: Optional Navidrome password for the username above. Required only for Navidrome API scan requests; the mounted music folder scan does not use this.

variables.name: Public App URL / Reverse Proxy URL
variables.description: Exact SpotifyBU base URL used for Spotify OAuth redirects. Spotify requires HTTPS except for loopback IPs such as http://127.0.0.1:3000. Normal Unraid/LAN installs should use an HTTPS reverse proxy, internal HTTPS hostname, VPN, or tunnel URL, then add NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL/api/auth/callback to the Spotify app.

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: Set true when SpotifyBU is accessed over HTTPS. Leave false only for direct HTTP/loopback testing.

variables.name: Chown Music Library
variables.description: Advanced repair option. Leave false unless you intentionally want SpotifyBU startup to recursively chown the entire mounted music library to PUID:PGID.

variables.name: Branch Label
variables.description: Branch label shown in the SpotifyBU footer
